Name: Simple Journal Pin
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[center][size=4][size=6][b][color=#F2C879]✦ Simple Journal Pin ✦[/color][/b][/size][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][size=5][b][color=#D8B4FE]💜 If you enjoy my mods, please consider endorsing this mod. Thank you for your support! ⭐[/color][/b][/size][/size][/center]
[size=4]
[b]Keep the quests you care about in view while you play.[/b]

Pin up to [b]six Journal quests[/b] and follow their live objectives, item icons and progress on your HUD. Choose your own order, adjust the display and open a quest directly from the tracker.

[b]PC 1.4 • Hidden by default for new settings • Optional two-column layout • Settings inside the Journal[/b]

New tracker settings start hidden. Pin quests normally, then use the gold reopen button, enable [b]Show tracker[/b] in the Journal cog settings, or use your assigned shortcut to reveal them. Reset also restores the hidden default. Existing saved Show/Hide choices are preserved.
[size=5][b][color=#8FDAC0]📌 Your quests, at a glance[/color][/b][/size][/size]
[center][size=4][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52801/52801-1791484463-995424743.png[/img][/size][/center]
[size=4][b]Journal preview:[/b] native quest entries with pin checkboxes and a settings cog.[/size]
[center][size=4][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52801/52801-1791484474-1424274927.png[/img][/size][/center]
[size=4]Manually unpinned quests stay unpinned. Pinning never completes quests or spends items.

[size=5][b][color=#F2C879]📖 A vertical tracker when shown[/color][/b][/size][/size]
[center][size=4][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52801/52801-1791484486-369925663.png[/img][/size][/center]
[size=4]
[b]When shown:[/b] one vertical list containing all six pins and their objectives. New settings keep the quest list hidden until you open it.

Prefer a wider display? Enable [b]Two-column tracker[/b] in the Journal cog or optional Generic Mod Config Menu. It stays off until you choose it.[/size]
[center][size=4][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52801/52801-1791484498-538544486.png[/img][/size][/center]
[size=4][b]Optional layout:[/b] the same six pins arranged in two columns. This is one tracker, with no paging.

Both layouts keep every objective visible. Long objectives wrap; exceptionally dense quests or very small viewports may need smaller text to fit. Other movable HUD widgets can still overlap your chosen position.

[size=5][b][color=#C8B0F4]⚙ Compact settings, familiar controls[/color][/b][/size][/size]
[center][size=4][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52801/52801-1791484509-1369501233.png[/img][/size][/center]
[size=4]
[b]Settings preview:[/b] compact rows, plain checkboxes, thick gold tabs and Save / Cancel / Reset buttons.

Use the [b]cogwheel above the Journal’s top-right corner[/b]. No extra menu mod is required. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] is optional and provides the same preferences.[/size]
[center][size=4][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52801/52801-1791484522-1882664848.png[/img][/size][/center]
[size=4]The tracker never switches to two columns automatically. Both layouts show the same six pins; there are no tracker pages.
[/size]
[center][size=4][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52801/52801-1791484533-825720026.png[/img][/size][/center]
[size=4]
Optional Generic Mod Config Menu retains its own Save/Cancel/Reset behaviour.
The show/hide shortcut works during ordinary gameplay with no menu or event open.

The tracker’s gold minus/plus control hides or reopens its contents. Hidden quests keep updating in the background. Display settings and order belong to each farmer; the optional hotkey is shared through this mod’s config.

[size=5][b][color=#9ACAF7]🧩 Compatibility[/color][/b][/size]
[/size]
[quote][size=4][b]Native quests and Special Orders[/b]
Supports standard Journal quests and Special Orders, including native structures used by Stardew Valley Expanded, Ridgeside Village and East Scarp. Quest names, translations and item sprites come from the game or their source mods. Unknown objectives use their own quest text where possible.[/size][/quote]
[quote][size=4][b]Journal and UI mods[/b]
Native rendering checks include Simple Journal Expansion, Deluxe Journal, Simple UI Themes and Simple UI Themes 2. The tracker leaves space for UI Info Suite 2 Alt status icons. Complete Journal replacements or quest systems outside the native quest lists may need their own integration.[/size][/quote]
[quote][size=4][b]Per-player tracking[/b]
Each farmer keeps separate pins and preferences, including shared Special Orders. Split-screen tracking uses each player’s UI viewport. This display does not change the shared quest’s actual rules or progress.[/size][/quote][size=4]
Validation used isolated native rendering and quest-data fixtures. Complete expansion/modpack playthroughs, multiplayer sessions and physical-controller testing remain unverified.

[size=5][b][color=#C8B0F4]📦 Requirements and installation[/color][/b][/size]

[b]PC edition:[/b] Stardew Valley 1.6.15 or later and [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI 4.4.0 or later[/url].
Optional: Generic Mod Config Menu. No content packs or other Simple mods are required.

1. Close the game and install SMAPI.
2. Extract the download.
3. Place the [b]SimpleJournalPin[/b] folder inside your game’s [b]Mods[/b] folder.
4. Launch through SMAPI, open the Journal and tick a quest checkbox.

When updating, replace the mod files and keep your config.json. Saved pins and per-farmer preferences are retained. Previously saved display choices are retained. You can hide an existing visible tracker with its gold collapse button or disable Show tracker and save.
[size=5][b][color=#8FDAC0]📱 Separate Android experiment[/color][/b][/size][/size]
[quote][size=4][b]Android Edition[/b]
The separate Android download shows the first three pins as passive text below the top-left icons. It has no tracker frame, arrows or HUD click targets; manage all six saved pins and their order through the Journal settings. It requires a compatible game/SMAPI port; PC SMAPI requirements do not confirm Android support.[/size][/quote][size=4]
Use [b]one edition at a time[/b]. PC and Android share the same mod ID. The separate Android 1.1 download is unchanged; the PC hidden default described above does not apply to it.
[size=5][b][color=#8FDAC0]💬 Good to know[/color][/b][/size][/size]
[quote][size=4][b]Does pinning change my quests?[/b]
No. The mod records its own pins and display preferences in farmer modData. It does not complete quests, consume items or grant rewards. Carrying items is not the same as donating them, and return-to-speak objectives remain until the game completes the quest.[/size][/quote]
[quote][size=4][b]Can I remove it?[/b]
Yes. Remove the SimpleJournalPin folder. Your quests, progress and unclaimed rewards remain in the normal Journal.[/size][/quote]
[quote][size=4][b]Languages[/b]
English, French, German, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Italian, Russian, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Turkish and Hungarian. Quest wording follows the original game or mod’s translations.[/size][/quote][size=4]
[size=5][b][color=#8FDAC0]🐛 Bug Reports & 💡 Suggestions[/color][/b][/size]
Include your game/mod/SMAPI versions and platform, expected versus actual behaviour, reproduction steps and a [url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI log link[/url]. Add the quest name and a useful screenshot or video. For unsupported objectives, run sjp_dumpquests with a save loaded and include the read-only report from this mod’s diagnostics folder. For suggestions, explain the change and how it would help.

Interface previews use the native renderer with illustrative sample quests. Stardew Valley and its native artwork/fonts belong to ConcernedApe.
[/size]
